per_candidate.id: s2:Anisotropy of Core-collapse Supernovae Effected by the Disks of Active Galactic

rationale: The papers 2404.08780, 2311.06782, and 2404.00937 investigate star formation processes in AGN disks, which may relate to the mechanisms driving massive star formation in the Galactic Centre, but do not conclusively settle the question.
